scope: Actual engine-context REST appearance, not gameplay

observations.silhouette: Recognizable giant spiral shell, asymmetric shield/claw and blade; shell reads broad bonnet/dish rather than reference tall rising stacked spiral, small compressed body and stance. All nine fit frame; top and rear naturally self-occlude face.
observations.face: Amber eyes and stalks discernible frontally but tiny/dark, face orange-red with visible fine stippling; beak and predatory expression less clean than reference.
observations.details: Shell stripes and asymmetric arm tools retained; reference crisp limb armor, purple-red material separation, beak and feet not matched at this capture scale.
observations.facet: Shell has readable large planes; dark body fine noisy/dither-like shading obscures intended clean faceted planes. Palette markedly darker, more ochre/orange and less cream/coral than approved image.
